requires.n: Soul Sister (Gain life when a creature enters)

4399-4518-6967--228.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Honest Rutstein.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, the "Soul Sister" card triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and the Soul Sister trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Sister trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4518-6967--228.notes:
The infinite lifegain, infinite lifeloss, and infinite energy counter results are only produced by specific soul sister effects.

If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

3139-5660-6769-6798.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3139-5660-6769-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
3139-5660-6769-6798.description:
Cast The Great Henge by paying {G}{G}. 
When The Great Henge enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing The Great Henge, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning The Great Henge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

1486-1651-7298.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Firdoch Core and another artifact, targeting Firdoch Core.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Firdoch Core.
Repeat.

4716-5900-8160.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
4716-5900-8160.notes: Alternate adding {G} and {U} each time. Start by adding the opposite of whatever mana you provide for the {G/U} in the cost.

1170-5060-5131-6495--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5060-5131-6495--202.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
1170-5060-5131-6495--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Cemetery Prowler.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
1170-5060-5131-6495--202.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2021-2060-3129-6774.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

2034-3375-4871-7147-7817.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Paradox Shaper // Omit Variables by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to The Immortal Sun.
Repeat.

2034-5189-7426-7803.easyPrerequisites: There are two removable +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.
2034-5189-7426-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
2034-5189-7426-7803.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Saproling, putting two +1/+1 counters on Berta due to Brad Boimler.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2292-2946-4871-6248.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2292-2946-4871-6248.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

186-4866-6822-7426.easyPrerequisites: There's a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
186-4866-6822-7426.description:
Activate Sage of Fables by paying {1} due to Heartstone and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

560-2457-4289-7297.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

3991-4050-5987.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Repeat from step 3.

57-955-2751-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-955-2751-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

413-5968-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.

1127-1129-3152.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Allies.
1127-1129-3152.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Blinking Spirit by paying {3}{W}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Harabaz Druid.
Activate Blinking Spirit by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1651-4321-5469.description:
Activate Transmutation Font's first ability by tapping it, creating a Clue, Food of Blood token and an additional Food token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two tokens, untapping Transmutation Font.
Repeat.

338-3197-3330.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3197-3330.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1020-3497-3689-6518.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2919-5641-6752.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-5641-6752.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
2919-5641-6752.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

3719-5147-6188-6307--85.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five creatures, excluding Fear of Missing Out, that have total power 1 or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill Fear of Missing Out or Luxurious Locomotive.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
3719-5147-6188-6307--85.description:
Activate Luxurious Locomotive's crew ability by tapping five creatures you control with total power 1 or greater, causing Luxurious Locomotive to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Luxurious Locomotive and Fear of Missing Out as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Luxurious Locomotive trigger, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out trigger, untapping Luxurious Locomotive and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Fear of Missing Out.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing two Treasures, returning Fear of Missing Out from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fear of Missing Out enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

224-1046-1993.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {G}.
224-1046-1993.notablePrerequisites: You control nine or fewer lands.
224-1046-1993.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Living Twister's second ability by paying {G}, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Budoka Gardener.
Repeat.

1251-3358-4881.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Activated Sleeper by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2232-2757-6251.manaNeeded: {3}{B}{B}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax if applicable
2232-2757-6251.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least six artifact and/or creature cards in your graveyard.
You control a basic Swamp and a basic Forest.
2232-2757-6251.description:
Cast Aatchik either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B}{B}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Aatchik enters the battlefield, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Aatchik trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token for each artifact and/or creature card in your graveyard.
When the Insects enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers that many times., returning Aatchik from the battlefield to your hand with the first trigger and returning nothing to your hand with each subsequent trigger.
Activate Earthcraft twice by tapping two Insects, untapping a basic Swamp and a basic Forest.
Activate the Swamp and Forest by tapping them, adding {B}{G}.
Repeat from step 6 two additional times.
Repeat from step 1.
2232-2757-6251.notes: If you have seven or more artifact and/or creature cards in your graveyard, this combo will net infinite untapped tokens and untap of basic lands you control.

4779-5365-5366.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue.
4779-5365-5366.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing the Clue.
Jenny Flint and Lonis' second ability trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Jenny Flint trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

1430-1617-4831-4983-5358.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
Mirror Image on the battlefield as a copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
1430-1617-4831-4983-5358.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur trigger twice.
Resolve both Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having Cacophodon fight Bellowing Aegisaur and Mirror Image to ensure neither dies due to lethal damage.

4499-4893-5421.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Redcap Thief.
When Redcap Thief enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

828-3129-4613-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Ascendant Spirit does not have summoning sickness and is an Angel.
An opponent cannot block Ascendant Spirit.
828-3129-4613-4762.description:
Activate Ascendant Spirit using Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ascendant Spirit using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat three additional times.
Activate Ascendant Spirit's third ability by paying {S}{S}{S}{S}, putting four +1/+1 counters on it and causing it to gain the listed ability.
Repeat until the number of instances of Ascendant Spirit's gained ability is equal to your deck size.
Move to your combat phase, and deal combat damage to an opponent using Ascendant Spirit.
Ascendant Spirit triggers once for each instance of the gained ability it has, causing you to draw that many cards.

803-1424-2534.notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond attached to Coercive Recruiter.
Coercive Recruiter does not have summoning sickness.
"Pirate" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1424-2534.description:
Activate Coercive Recruiter by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
When the Elf Warrior enters the battlefield as a Pirate due to Arcane Adaptation, Coercive Recruiter triggers, untapping Coercive Recruiter.
Repeat.

1061-1379-3499-4331.notablePrerequisites: You control at least eight permanents and/or have the city's blessing.
1061-1379-3499-4331.description:
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Drafna's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying Timestream Navigator.
When the Timestream Navigators enter the battlefield, if you do not have the city's blessing, they trigger, giving you the city's blessing.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning the nontoken Timestream Navigator from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Timestream Navigator token by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each turn.

914-1522.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least eight artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1522.description:
Cast Dockisde Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least eight Treasure tokens.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{U}{U}{R}.
Cast Disappear by paying {2}{U}{U}, attaching it to Dockside Extortionist.
Activate Disappear by paying {U}, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to your hand.
Repeat.

573-1479-3678.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
573-1479-3678.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Emeria, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

518-1691-3733-3994.notablePrerequisites: an additional Golem on the battlefield.
518-1691-3733-3994.description:
Before damage cast Ephemeral Shields, targeting any of the golems.
Precursor Golem's ability triggers, copying Shields to the other golems and giving each indestructible until the end of turn.
Cast Jeskai Charm, choosing the mode to give your creatures lifelink until the end of turn.
Cast Arcbond, targeting one of the golems.
Precursor Golem's ability triggers, copying Arcbond onto the other golems.
Once a Golem takes damage, the ability given by Arcbond triggers, reflecting the damage onto all players and all other creatures.
Because of lifelink, you gain life while all other players lose life.
As the ability deals damage to the other golems, their Arcbond abilities trigger in response, doing the same.
